customtooltips.tooltip_edit_screen.title: Edit Tooltip [Hold CTRL for Live Preview]
Tooltip Background Options
customtooltips.option.target.desc:
Accepts exact IDs §c(minecraft:apple)§f, tags §6(#c:swords)§f, namespaces §e(minecraft:*)§f, regex §a(regex:.*_sword)§f, all items §b(*)§f and negation §c(!)§f.

§eNote:§r§f Tags are world-specific and will only appear in the dropdown after loading a world.
customtooltips.option.text.desc:
Accepts multiple lines of text.

Inline color/formatting codes (e.g., §c&c§r, §l&l§r) only work with the Solid style. Use the toggles below for gradient text formatting.

§eTip:§r Use dynamic placeholders like §b%max_durability%§r, §b%weapon_damage%§r or §b%enchantments%§r, and embed translations and keybinds using §b<translation:translation.key>§r and §b<key:translation.key>§r correspondingly(e.g. §b<key:key.forward>§r -> §b[W]§r).

§eNote:§r Make sure you have setup your translations in a custom resource pack.
customtooltips.option.style.desc:
The rendering and animation style.

§6Solid:§r Single static color.
§6Static Gradient:§r Fixed gradient between two colors.
§6Slide Gradient:§r Animated gradient between two colors.
§6Breathing Gradient:§r Fixed gradient that pulsates back and forth.
§6Rainbow:§r Animated flowing rainbow.
customtooltips.option.primary_color.desc:
Choose the primary color using the visual picker.

Also accepts manual input of colors.

Valid formats:
§7Minecraft color names (e.g. '§6gold§7')
Legacy formatting codes (e.g. '§d&d§7')
Hex color codes: §c#FF0000§7, §a00FF00§7, §b0x0000FF§7, §ex0000FF§7
customtooltips.option.secondary_color.de:
Choose the secondary color (used for Gradients) using the visual picker.

Also accepts manual input of colors.

Valid formats:
§7Minecraft color names (e.g. '§6gold§7')
Legacy formatting codes (e.g. '§d&d§7')
Hex color codes: §c#FF0000§7, §a00FF00§7, §b0x0000FF§7, §ex0000FF§7
customtooltips.option.border_top_color.d: The color of the top part of the tooltip's border. Creates a gradient with the bottom color.
customtooltips.option.border_bottom_colo: The color of the bottom part of the tooltip's border. Creates a gradient with the top color.
customtooltips.option.background_top_col: The color of the tooltip's background, or of its top part with Gradient. With a texture, it colors the 1 px outline around it.
customtooltips.option.background_bottom_: The color of the bottom part of the tooltip's background, which fades from the top color. Solid does not use it.
customtooltips.option.background_type.de:
The background type of the tooltip.

§6Solid:§r Single static color.
§6Gradient:§r Fixed gradient between two colors.
§6Texture (Stretch):§r Stretches the entire image to fit the tooltip. Best for seamless patterns, noisy backgrounds, or large abstract images.
§6Texture (Framed):§r Uses smart scaling (Nine-Slice). Corners and borders keep their original thickness while the center stretches. Best for RPG frames, custom UI boxes, or drawn borders.
§6Texture (Repeating):§r Scales and repeats the selected texture inside the tooltip. Best for making patterns appear inside your Tooltip.
customtooltips.option.background_texture:
The texture to use for the background. Place .png files in config/custom_tooltip_api/backgrounds/.

§eNote:§r For 'Framed' mode, textures are mapped to a 64x64 grid with 8px corners. You can use larger HD images (e.g., 128x128 with 16px corners) as long as the proportions match!

§eNote:§r New or changed files in that folder load with F3+T.

§bTip:§f Transparencies as well as animated textures (using .mcmeta files) are fully supported.§r
customtooltips.option.background_scale.d: Adjusts the scale of the background texture. Only applies to 'Texture (Framed)' and 'Texture (Repeating)' background types.
customtooltips.option.position.desc:
Insert (Top) §7(Under the item's name)§r
Insert (Bottom) §7(Bottom of the tooltip)§r
Replace Name §7(Replaces the item's name)§r
Replace Line §7(Replaces an individual tooltip line)§r
Replace All §7(Replaces the entire tooltip)§r
Append §7(End of a line)§r
Prepend §7(Start of a line)§r
customtooltips.option.line_offset.desc:
Offsets the line position in the tooltip.
Accepts positive integers if position is set to §6Top§r, §6Replace Line§r, §6Append§r, §6Prepend§r, or negative integers if position is set to §6Bottom§r.
customtooltips.option.font.desc:
The font ID to use. Leave as 'minecraft:default' for the default font.

§eNote:§r Place .ttf files in config/custom_tooltip_api/fonts/ and press F3+T to load them.
customtooltips.option.bold.desc: If the displayed text should be §lbold§r.
customtooltips.option.italic.desc: If the displayed text should be §oitalic§r.
customtooltips.option.underlined.desc: If the displayed text should be §nunderlined§r.
customtooltips.option.strikethrough.desc: If the displayed text should be §mstrikethrough§r.
customtooltips.option.obfuscated.desc: If the displayed text should be §kobfuscated§r (obfuscated).
customtooltips.option.require_keybind.de:
If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when holding the secondary details key (Default: Shift).

§eNote:§r You can rebind this key in Minecraft's Controls menu.
Adds an empty line before the tooltip.
Only works with the Insert (Top) and Insert (Bottom) positions.
customtooltips.option.animation_offset.d: Animation offset that desynchronizes different animations.
customtooltips.option.tickrate.desc:
Cycle duration of the animation.
100 is normal speed, 50 is fast, 200 is slow.
Reverses the animation of the gradient.
Only works with §6Slide§r, §6Breathing§r, and §6Rainbow§r gradients.
customtooltips.option.hide_vanilla_lines:
If enabled, removes all default vanilla lore and stats from the item before injecting this custom tooltip. With Requires Keybind, they are only removed while the key is held.

§eTip:§r Great for completely redesigning an item's description from scratch.
customtooltips.option.show_only_if_damag: If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when the item has lost durability.
customtooltips.option.show_only_if_encha: If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when the item has at least one enchantment.
customtooltips.option.show_only_if_unbre: If enabled, the tooltip will only appear when the item possesses the Unbreakable tag.
customtooltips.option.background_opacity:
Adjusts the transparency of the tooltip's background by multiplying the alpha of its colors or its texture.

§eNote:§r 1 keeps them as chosen, 0 makes them invisible. For a more opaque background, raise the alpha of its colors. Default is 1.
customtooltips.option.border_opacity.des:
Adjusts the transparency of the tooltip's borders by multiplying the alpha of their colors.

§eNote:§r 1 keeps them as chosen, 0 makes them invisible. For more opaque borders, raise the alpha of their colors. Default is 1.
